desc:
Sweetened whole grain oat cereal with real honey and natural almond flavor in every delicious spoonful; Whole grain oats are the first ingredient in this honey nut cereal for kids and adults; An ideal pantry staple


CAN HELP LOWER CHOLESTEROL as part of a heart healthy diet; 3g of soluble fiber daily from whole grain oat foods, in a diet low in saturated fat and cholesterol, may reduce the risk of heart disease; Honey Nut Cheerios provides .75g per serving


Pour it in a bowl with cold milk for an irresistible, gluten free part of an easy breakfast; Pack some up in a lunch box for gluten free snacks on the go; Add to homemade cereal bars and other kids snack food recipes


22g of whole grain (at least 48g recommended daily), 12 vitamins and minerals, and is a good source of calcium and fiber per serving


CONTAINS: One cardboard box of crunchy Honey Nut Cheerios, Heart Healthy Gluten Free Breakfast Cereal, 10.8 oz; Perfect for instant snacking, or a part of breakfast and meals
features:
Features

Whole grain is the first ingredient, providing a heart-healthy foundation.
Lightly sweetened with real honey for a delicious, smooth flavor in every bite.
Made without wheat, barley, or rye—safe for individuals with gluten sensitivities.
Sweetened with sugar and honey, not overly processed syrups.
Includes nutrients like iron, calcium, zinc, and a full range of B vitamins.
A heart-smart choice for everyday breakfast.
Classic Cheerio shape with a satisfying crunch that holds up in milk.
Loved by both kids and adults for its subtly sweet, nutty taste.

Benefits

Whole grain oats help lower cholesterol as part of a heart-healthy diet.
Easy to eat, easy to digest, and appealing to toddlers, teens, and adults alike.
Packed with nutrients in every serving—an effortless way to start your day strong.
Enjoy it with milk, as a dry snack, or mixed into recipes like cereal bars or snack mixes.
Naturally low in fat and calories—helps support weight and health goals without sacrificing flavor.
Perfect for busy mornings, lunchboxes, or afternoon snacking.
ingredients: Whole Grain Oats, Sugar, Corn Starch, Honey, Brown Sugar Syrup, Salt, Tripotassium Phosphate, Canola and/or Sunflower Oil, Natural Almond Flavor. Vitamin E (mixed tocopherols) Added to Preserve Freshness. Vitamins and Minerals: Calcium Carbonate, Vitamin C (sodium ascorbate), Iron and Zinc (mineral nutrients), A B Vitamin (niacinamide), Vitamin B6 (pyridoxine hydrochloride), Vitamin B1 (thiamin mononitrate), Vitamin A (palmitate), Vitamin B2 (riboflavin), A B Vitamin (folic acid), Vitamin B12, Vitamin D3.
